comparison.objective: Pack three cases under a fragility and stacking constraint, not tune a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Plans placement order, orients cases, and stacks them in tight bays; no fine rotary adjustment or dynamic inspection.
comparison.success_condition: All cases flat and lengthwise, at most two per bay, with nothing on the blue case versus two repeatable damper stops.
comparison.reason: This tests constrained packing and load-path planning, not mechanical commissioning.
